name: FlashAttention-3 Hopper full-GPU mechanism candidate pool

h100_cycle_filter.measurement: GPU kernel cycles collected during qualification; not a simulator parameter

tuning_policy: axis in {batch,seqlen_k,num_splits,repeat_seqlens_batch}; values is an ordered legal list. Default is batch doubling. Varlen/sparse uses repeat_seqlens_batch to keep long/short ratio. Apply with apply_tuning(); never loop the same launch.

tuning.rule: Pick one value from tuning.values and apply via apply_tuning(). That changes real tokens/batch/splits. Never loop the same launch to inflate cycles. Every listed value must keep primary_mechanism triggers.
tuning.forbidden: do not repeat the same launch / loop the kernel to inflate cycles
